scope_skipped: application/runtime architecture: none established by repository evidence

findings.title: Retire stale active plans against the authoritative upgrade brief

evidence.observation: The user confirms the current working-tree brief is authoritative as of this audit.
Multiple plans describe slices already anchored by recent commits but remain in active/ without superseded/completed state.

findings.impact: Future audits can re-plan already delivered work or misclassify current upgrade requirements if plan lifecycle state remains ambiguous.
findings.fix_sketch: Keep the confirmed upgrade brief unchanged, produce a 1-70 status matrix, then move or mark completed/superseded plans only after checking their evidence and preserving history.

findings.title: Add evidence-backed repository intelligence and verification-quality controls

evidence.observation: Ownership discovery is limited to literal CODEOWNERS locations and returns UNAVAILABLE without a policy or architecture relation source.
Mission dispatch produces advisory isolated-worktree contracts only; no execution, retry, integration, or mission verification runtime exists.
Effect inference is conservative argv analysis and explicitly does not infer tool/API semantics or enforce authorization.

findings.impact: KEEL cannot yet discover ownership/architecture impact or independently prove several classes of change and effect behavior.
findings.fix_sketch: Define repository-owned source contracts, bounded architecture/impact relations, typed semantic assertions, independent-oracle and scope-laundering checks, and keep advisory inference separate from authorization.
open_questions: Which consumer repositories and providers are in scope for semantic adapters?

findings.title: Establish representative empirical evaluation and feedback promotion

evidence.observation: The repository contains validation/schema/scoring infrastructure, but no completed paired trial establishes KEEL uplift.
Feedback can be queued and target plans projected, while target execution, scheduling, and promotion remain absent.
tokens, cost, human_interventions, retries, and merge_conflicts are explicitly UNAVAILABLE without runtime instrumentation.

findings.impact: The framework’s strategic effectiveness and economics remain assertions rather than reproducible evidence, and reviewed observations cannot complete the learning loop.
findings.fix_sketch: Approve a representative corpus/rubric, run repeated no-skill versus KEEL trials, add available runtime telemetry, and define reviewed queue-to-evaluation-to-promotion contracts.
open_questions: Who is the evaluation authority and what task corpus is authorized?

findings.title: Make installation, compatibility, and mission execution portable

evidence.observation: Codex version and runtime hooks are reported UNVERIFIED; the repository does not prove external runtime compatibility.
A local config migration engine exists, but installer and live authorized orchestration are not present.
The CLI exposes mission planning/dispatch projections but no run command or execution runtime.

findings.impact: The framework remains repository-local and advisory; it cannot be reproducibly installed, upgraded, or execute a governed mission across providers.
findings.fix_sketch: Define package/install/version contracts, runtime capability handshake, reproducible environment/candidate metadata, then add isolated mission execution with retry and integration boundaries.
open_questions: Which supported Codex/provider/runtime versions are authorized?

findings.title: Define authorized external integrations and product surfaces after the runtime contract

evidence.observation: The brief explicitly makes run responsible for scheduling, authorization, sealing, integration, and mission verification.
Tracker/PR integration is deferred pending authorization and runtime prerequisites.

findings.impact: Premature tracker, dashboard, or product-surface work would fossilize unresolved runtime and policy contracts.
findings.fix_sketch: After the runtime and API contracts stabilize, specify CLI structured-output/API compatibility, tracker/PR effects and authorization, and only then evaluate dashboard needs.
